prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: single 74x100 dialogue head portrait for Elaine Voss (伊莲·沃斯, NPC04).
Input image roles: Image 1 is her historical identity reference only: retain the square mature cheekbones, substantial nose/nostril wings, dark brown swept-back low-bun hairstyle, dark navy and brown clothing colors. Images 2-5 are approved pixel portrait style and framing references (Mara, Ivo, Leiya, Tor), NOT her identity or their expressions.
Primary request: Redraw the same woman using those coarse hard pixel planes and very tight face composition. Current card overrides historical proportions: she is a woman in her MID-FORTIES, a poised LOCAL port authority agent and careful accountant, never a national ruler. Clearly adult slightly rectangular broad face, square cheekbones and firm jaw; substantial straight nose with visible broad nostril wings; modest thin closed lips. Add restrained middle-age lines under the small eyes and beside the mouth. Skin a muted warm ochre/terracotta, with broad pale warm planes and medium-brown shadows.
Expression: level, composed professional appraisal with guarded confidence and matter-of-fact accountability. Near-horizontal substantial eyebrows with the inner ends relaxed, not raised inward. A faint asymmetry of one lowered eyelid and a firm level closed mouth. NO worried inverted-V brows, no sadness, no pleading, no angry scowl, no smile or beautified doe eyes. Gaze a little toward viewer-left; head near frontal with a modest three-quarter turn. Upright dignified head posture.
Hair: dark warm brown hair neatly swept backward into a low compact bun visible as a small side mass behind the head; 4-6 large interlocking angular locks, a few restrained muted gray-brown age strands grouped into broad blocks, no individual hairs. She is plainly recognizably the same woman as reference 1, aged to her current forties card.
Costume only a tiny bottom edge: ordinary dark navy official wool outer collar and dark brown robe with narrow muted off-white linen undercollar. Avoid jewelry, crown, elaborate authority badge, medal, shoulder expanses, staff or state symbols. The fee plaque is below this tight crop and need not be visible.
Medium: serious grounded medieval RPG low-resolution hard-edged pixel portrait. Design expressly on a 74x100 logical grid. If larger output is unavoidable, it must look like uniform nearest-neighbor enlargement of those coarse pixels, not detailed art prepared for later shrinking. Large connected flat color clusters, sharp stepped contours. Strong warm near-black silhouette; constructed broad nose bridge, cheekbone and jaw planes. At most 32 visible palette colors. Matte skin and cloth. No gradients, soft antialiasing, dithering, stipple noise, glossy eyes or single-hair detail.
Framing: EXTREMELY TIGHT head-only dialogue portrait, as tightly filled as images 2-5. Crown 1-2 logical pixels from top; face/head silhouette occupies 90-97 percent of height and almost all width. Chin at about row 90; collar only the bottom 5-8 rows. No bust, visible torso, long neck, generous margins, prop or hands. Small deep-set human eyes with only muted tiny sclera slivers, not the enlarged eyes of image 1. Broad uninterrupted facial clusters and anatomical planes.
Background: genuine transparent alpha outside the silhouette. Single person, single portrait, no panels, label, letters, symbols, text, frame, UI or backdrop.
